summary: Created the shared project memory (requirements with stable ids, recommendations kept apart from confirmed requirements, 30 open questions, 9 human decisions, 8 proposed ADRs, roadmap), the root CLAUDE.md worker protocol, the architect reviewer prompt, strict JSON schemas for tasks, run reports, architect decisions and the policy, a deterministic policy.json, and a zero-dependency offline validator (ops/validate-memory.mjs plus two libraries) with 144 tests, 3 valid and 32 invalid fixtures. The work was done in an isolated worktree on a new local branch based on the remote integration branch, leaving the main working tree, the unpushed Reel commits and creative/ untouched. No workflow, secret, environment, external call or website change was made, and nothing was pushed. Lint, type check and production build pass and match the pristine baseline; the memory validator and its tests pass.

risk.rationale: The work touches control-plane files (CLAUDE.md, ops/, policy, schemas, architect prompt), governed memory and package.json, which policy classes as B. No class C path was touched.

deviations.description: Added a fourth schema, policy.schema.json, beyond the three requested.
deviations.reason: policy.json is enforced by code, so it needs the same strict contract as the other documents.

deviations.description: Modified the existing package.json to add two scripts, ops:validate and ops:test. No dependency, script or config entry was changed or removed.
deviations.reason: The validator and its tests need a standard way to run; the task also asked to keep compatibility with the existing setup. This is the only existing file that changed.

deviations.description: The ops:test script passes a shell glob (ops/tests/*.test.mjs) instead of a directory.
deviations.reason: Node 22 treats a directory argument as a module and fails; a glob works on all supported Node versions.

deviations.description: Held the public site (ui_public_site) at class B in the policy, although the Phase 0 audit suggested UI changes could be class A.
deviations.reason: No automated visual-regression baselines exist yet, so automatic approval would be unsafe; recorded as OQ-0027.

deviations.description: Also committed a task record for OPS-0001 and this run report so the contracts are exercised on a real task.
deviations.reason: Dogfooding the task and report formats shows they are practical and validates them on real data.

unresolved_issues.description: The Next.js production build is not reproducible across checkout paths: two pristine checkouts at different paths produce different chunk hashes, while the same path is reproducible. Any future build-output comparison (for example visual or bundle regression in CI) must compare builds at the same path.

Whether the architect decision schema is accepted by the OpenAI Responses API in strict structured-output mode is unverified, because the OpenAI documentation could not be fetched from this environment. It must be contract-tested before stage STG-4 relies on it.

policy.json is draft_pending_human_review and all ADRs are proposed, because the Phase 0 modifications have not been itemised (OQ-0020). All limit and budget values are recommendations, not decisions.
The ops:test script relies on shell glob expansion and may not work in a Windows cmd shell; CI and this environment use sh.

assumptions: The 'appropriate clean remote integration baseline' is origin/claude-dev (b7348bb), the integration branch in the Phase 0 branch model. It differs from origin/main only by the 140 creative/ files; website source and configuration are byte-identical between the two.
A separate worktree outside the repository directory is an acceptable form of isolation.
The task record and the run report may be committed on this branch as part of the task.
